title: How good is Bo Nix compared to the other quarterbacks drafted in the first round of the 2024 NFL Draft?
text:
Bo Nix is one of the most polarizing players in the NFL.filler filler filler test


Code
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalt)
library(ggrepel)

nix <- read_csv("bo_nix.csv")
williams <- read_csv("caleb_williams.csv")
daniels <- read_csv("jayden_daniels.csv")
maye <- read_csv("drake_maye.csv")
penix <- read_csv("michael_penix.csv")
mccarthy <- read_csv("jj_mccarthy.csv")




Code
quarterbacks <- bind_rows(
  mutate(nix, player = "Bo Nix"),
  mutate(williams, player = "Caleb Williams"),
  mutate(daniels, player = "Jayden Daniels"),
  mutate(maye, player = "Drake Maye"),
  mutate(penix, player = "Michael Penix Jr."),
  mutate(mccarthy, player = "J.J. McCarthy")
)




Code
quarterbacks <- quarterbacks |>
  mutate(
    wins = as.numeric(str_split_fixed(QBrec, "-", 3)[, 1]),
    losses = as.numeric(str_split_fixed(QBrec, "-", 3)[, 2]),
    ties = as.numeric(str_split_fixed(QBrec, "-", 3)[, 3])
  )

career <- quarterbacks |>
  group_by(player) |>
  summarize(
    games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    starts = sum(GS, na.rm = TRUE),
    wins = sum(wins, na.rm = TRUE),
    losses = sum(losses, na.rm = TRUE),
    ties = sum(ties, na.rm = TRUE),
    touchdowns = sum(TD, na.rm = TRUE),
    interceptions = sum(Int, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    td_per_game = touchdowns / games,
    win_pct = (wins + 0.5 * ties) / (wins + losses + ties)
  )




Code
bo_nix <- career |>
  filter(player == "Bo Nix")




Code
ggplot() +
  geom_bar(
    data = career,
    aes(x = reorder(player, wins), weight = wins),
    fill = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_bar(
    data = bo_nix,
    aes(x = reorder(player, wins), weight = wins),
    fill = "navy"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Bo Nix leads his draft class in wins",
    subtitle = "Quarterback wins from 2024 through the available 2026 games.",
    x = "",
    y = "Career wins",
    caption = "Source: Pro Football Reference | Graphic: Stephen Tran"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9)
  )











Code
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = career,
    aes(x = touchdowns, y = interceptions),
    color = "gray",
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = bo_nix,
    aes(x = touchdowns, y = interceptions),
    color = "navy",
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = career,
    aes(
      x = touchdowns,
      y = interceptions,
      label = player
    ),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bo Nix leads in touchdowns, but interceptions add up",
    subtitle = "Career passing touchdowns compared with interceptions for the six first-round quarterbacks.",
    x = "Career passing touchdowns",
    y = "Career interceptions",
    caption = "Source: Pro Football Reference | Graphic: Stephen Tran"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9)
  )

    data = career,
    aes(x = reorder(player, td_per_game), weight = td_per_game),

  ) +

    aes(x = reorder(player, td_per_game), weight = td_per_game),
